 'sqrt_t_and_t': (lambda p: p[0]*np.exp(-p[1]*t)*A**3 + p[2]*np.sqrt(t)+p[3]*t+p[4], 5),
 'log': (lambda p: p[0]*np.exp(-p[1]*t)*A**3 + p[2]*np.log(t+p[3])+p[4], 5),
 'expdecay_k': (lambda p: p[0]*np.exp(-p[1]*t)*A**3 + p[2]*(1-np.exp(-p[3]*t))+p[4], 5),
 'expdecay_k_t': (lambda p: p[0]*np.exp(-p[1]*t)*A**3 + p[2]*t*np.exp(-p[3]*t)+p[4], 5),
 'sat': (lambda p: p[0]*np.exp(-p[1]*t)*A**3 + p[2]*t/(p[3]+t)+p[4], 5),
}
for name,(f,n) in fs.items():
